_comment: The only finding codes a device report pkg.scan may carry (plus threat-<n>, an engine threat id): the MCP reputation reason codes (data/mcp-reputation.js REASON_WEIGHTS) and the package heuristic ids (cli/mcp-package/heuristics.mjs HEURISTICS). Read by cli/mcp-package/pkg-report.mjs and, at compile time, src-tauri/src/mcp_pkg.rs. test/mcp-pkg-report.test.mjs fails when a code is added without regenerating this list.
